title: Demis Hassabis, James Manyika and Shane Legg's 'Introducing the DeepMind Institute'. Three Companies, Three Rooms, No Levers.
short_version: Three AI companies, one week, three rooms for the rest of us to talk in. Microsoft a consultation, OpenAI a foundation, Google DeepMind an institute that says it shouldn't be technologists alone, signed by three of them. Ask of each room: what can the people in it stop?
